game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Shadow Pit Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit, a pit of deep shadow: the torchbearer must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit: a pit of deep shadow
core_gameplay_loop: In Shadow Pit, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the ore lift using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The ore lift reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the ore lift is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how dungeon_clear changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Shadow Pit.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The ore lift reached with actions_used <= 14.
